title: 标准 MCP 服务的工具和能力无法加载

history.evidence: The fix diff adds wire-name annotations throughout client protocol structures; commit records a standard tools/list response failing with missing input_schema. Related commits show sequential distinct interoperability failures, not repeated attempts at this exact root cause.

problem_zh: 连接符合 MCP 协议的服务后，握手可能成功，但获取工具列表失败；部分能力开关和图像结果也不能正确读取。请查明跨协议边界的原因并修复，使标准服务的响应能够正确读取和回传，同时保留纯文本工具与普通 JSON-RPC 响应行为。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
